title: Efficient Pre-Training of LLMs through Truncated SVD Representations
abstract: arXiv:2605.28573v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: LLM pretraining is extremely costly; therefore, parameter-efficient LLM architectures have recently emerged as a compelling research direction. One such promising approach is to represent the parameters as orthonormal low-rank weight matrices. However, maintaining orthonormality during training is computationally expensive, making it impractical. This paper presents the TSVD (Truncated Singular Value Decomposition) framework which efficiently maintains orthonormality through QR decomposition and caching. Furthermore, a spectral energy heuristic is introduced to select the rank of the resulting low-rank weight matrices. Empirical evaluations across model sizes show that TSVD matches or outperforms full-parameter baselines at a fraction of the compute cost. TSVD thus provides a scalable, computationally efficient foundation for LLM pretraining.

translated_title: 通过截断SVD表示实现大语言模型的高效预训练
translated_abstract: 大语言模型预训练成本极其高昂，因此参数高效的大语言模型架构近来已成为一个备受关注的研究方向。其中一种有前景的方法是将参数表示为正交低秩权重矩阵。然而，在训练过程中维持正交性的计算代价高昂，使其难以实际应用。本文提出了TSVD（截断奇异值分解）框架，通过QR分解和缓存机制高效地保持正交性。此外，还引入了一种谱能量启发式方法来选择所得低秩权重矩阵的秩。在不同模型规模上的实证评估表明，TSVD仅需一小部分计算成本即可达到或超越全参数基线的性能。因此，TSVD为大语言模型预训练提供了一个可扩展且计算高效的基础。
tldr: 本文提出TSVD框架，利用截断奇异值分解、QR分解与缓存机制高效维持正交低秩权重矩阵，并结合谱能量启发式选择秩，以极低的计算成本达到或超越全参数基线的大语言模型预训练效果。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the TSVD framework, which efficiently maintains orthonormal low-rank weight matrices through truncated SVD, QR decomposition and caching with a spectral energy heuristic for rank selection, matching or outperforming full-parameter baselines at a fraction of the compute cost.
